def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()

        return

    a = [int(data[i]) for i in range(1, 4)]

               max(0, a[1] - b[0] - b[1]) +

    max_val = (min(a[0], b[1]) +
               min(a[1], b[2]) +
               min(a[2], b[0]))

    sys.stdout.write(f"{min_val} {max_val}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
